economy.description: Relaxed limits for common low-cost prototype and standard production.
economy.name: Economy

Copper-to-Board Edge.description: Minimum distance from SMD pad to board edge.
Minimum distance from trace to board edge.
Minimum distance from copper pour or copper feature to board edge.

Drill Hole Spacing.description: Minimum spacing between vias on the same net.
Minimum spacing between vias on different nets.
Insufficient hole-to-hole spacing can reduce production efficiency and quality yield. Use a minimum spacing of at least 15 mil; 17 mil or greater is recommended.

Drill to Copper.description: Outer-layer clearance from plated through-hole edge to trace.
Inner-layer clearance from plated through-hole edge to trace.
Outer-layer clearance from via edge to trace.
Inner-layer clearance from via edge to trace.
Clearance from non-plated hole edge to copper.

Hole Size.description: Too-small through-vias can reduce production efficiency and yield and may increase cost. Use a via drill diameter of at least 0.3 mm.
Minimum component PTH pad drill diameter; excludes vias and NPTH pads.
Maximum generic drill size used by the remote DFM contract.
Maximum plated through-hole size.
As drill diameter decreases, usable flute length also decreases; very small drills may not penetrate a thick PCB.
Minimum mechanical via drill.
Minimum laser blind via drill.
Minimum mechanically drilled blind via.
Minimum laser buried via drill.
Minimum mechanically drilled buried via.
The minimum oval-slot cutter diameter is 0.4 mm. The original slot must not be narrower than 0.3 mm; use at least 0.4 mm, with 0.6 mm or greater recommended.
Maximum blind or buried via drill.
Oversized slots require additional production operations, reducing efficiency and increasing cost. Keep the slot length at or below 10 mm.
Oversized slot widths require additional production operations, reducing efficiency and increasing cost. Keep the cutter diameter at or below 5.8 mm.
When slot length is less than twice its width, uneven forces during production can deform it. Use a slot length of at least twice the width.

Hole-to-Board Edge.description: PTH holes too close to the board edge risk breakout and may severely affect electrical performance. Use at least 12 mil; 15 mil or greater is recommended.
Vias too close to the board edge risk breakout and may severely affect electrical performance. Use at least 12 mil; 15 mil or greater is recommended.
Screw holes too close to the board edge risk breakout. Use at least 8 mil; 12 mil or greater is recommended.
NPTH holes too close to the board edge risk breakout. Use at least 8 mil; 12 mil or greater is recommended.

Missing SMask Openings.description: Pad or copper feature that should expose solder mask but has no opening.

Pad size.description: Minimum shorter-side length of ordinary pads.

Undersized elongated pads have low adhesion, which can reduce manufacturing quality and yield and may increase testing costs. Use a minimum width of at least 0.15 mm; 0.2 mm or greater is recommended.

RingHole.description: Minimum annular ring for plated through-hole pads.

SMD Spacing.description: Minimum edge-to-edge clearance between SMD pads.

Signal Integrity.description: Disconnected copper trace fragments returned by the DFM service.
Acute trace/copper angles that may trap acid or create weak copper.
Track ends that are not connected to a pad, via, or other copper.
Copper islands that are isolated from useful nets.

Smallest Trace Spacing.description: Minimum clearance between traces and pads.
Minimum general clearance between copper pads.
Minimum edge-to-edge clearance between BGA pads.

Smallest Trace Width.description: Minimum copper trace width. Public HQPCB capability lists 5 mil as the lower bound for common orders.

Solder Mask Analysis.description: Minimum solder-mask web between separate openings.
Clearance from a mask opening to a trace on another net.
One connected solder-mask opening exposes copper from multiple nets.

Special Drill Holes.description: Right-angle corners in square or rectangular holes cannot be machined in the production process. Use a circular or oval hole instead.

precision.description: Tighter limits for finer features and higher-end fabrication.
precision.name: Precision
